info.name: Navora — Neuromorphic Adaptive Navigation API
info.description: Comprehensive development collection for the master-prompt REST + FastAPI contracts. Browser-only WebAuthn, Google Identity Services, WebRTC, Bluetooth, Geolocation and camera permission flows are represented by their server contracts; they must be exercised in the browser for true end-to-end validation. Simulation data is explicitly labelled and is not live traffic.

request.description: Access and refresh tokens are stored in HttpOnly cookies.
Credential-dependent: obtain a real Google ID token in the browser; never place Google passwords here.
WebAuthn responses must be browser-generated; this is a contract placeholder.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 400) { const j=pm.response.json(); const r=j?.data?.routes?.[0]; if(r?.databaseId) pm.collectionVariables.set('routeId', r.databaseId); }
if (pm.response.code < 400) { const j=pm.response.json(); const x=j?.data; if(x?._id) pm.collectionVariables.set('journeyId', x._id); }
if (pm.response.code < 400) { const j=pm.response.json(); if(j?.data?.token) pm.collectionVariables.set('shareToken', j.data.token); }

request.description: Provide a browser-captured image. Raw image is sent for inference but not persisted by default.
